Second transcription's note: There is no support test for the EIC. The married-child rule and the kidnapped-child rule (Pub. 596) are refused. The tie-breaker rules for a qualifying child of more than one person cannot be decided from the interface; listing the child is read as the filer claiming the child under those rules.

Second transcription's note: A child aged 13 at the end of 2025 turned 13 during the year and qualifies only for care provided before the birthday (dc_under13); a child 12 or under was under 13 all year. A person who would be a dependent but for gross income, a joint return or the filer's own dependency, and the custodial-parent rule, are outside this slice (asked at the Form 2441 level). Only birth or death, as Pub. 503 states, relaxes the half-year test here.

## Raw second transcription

```yaml
lines:
  - id: dependent.h_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Zero (-0-)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}

  - id: dependent.one
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One person listed in the Dependents section"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: param, ref: dependent.one}
    note: "The pages give no computation for this interface; read as the unit count (1) for one listed person."

  - id: dependent.h_qc_rel
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1: A qualifying child is your son, daughter, stepchild, foster child, brother, sister, stepbrother, stepsister, half brother, half sister, or a descendant of any of them"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "child"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling_descendant"}]}

  - id: dependent.h_qc_age
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1: Under age 19 at the end of 2025 and younger than you (or your spouse if filing jointly), or under age 24, a full-time student and younger than you (or your spouse if filing jointly), or any age and permanently and totally disabled"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.disabled, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.younger, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: qc.age_limit}]}
                - op: test
                  all:
                    - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: qc.student_age_limit}]}
                    - {op: test, eq: [dependent.student, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1: Do you have a child who meets the conditions to be your qualifying child?"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc_rel, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc_age, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.self_support, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.joint_return, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, ge: [dependent.months, {const: 7, type: Count}]}
    refuses: [dependent.divorced_rule, dependent.kidnapped, dependent.married]
    note: "Residency is read from the months answer, which already carries the temporary-absence, birth, death, adoption and placement exceptions. The kidnapped-child rule depends on facts outside the interface (time lived with you before the kidnapping or after the return), so a kidnapped child is refused, as are the divorced-parents rule and a married person. The tie-breaker rules for a qualifying child of more than one person need parentage and AGI facts that are not in the interface; listing the person is read as the filer claiming the child under those rules."

  - id: dependent.h_rel_listed
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4: Son, daughter, stepchild, foster child, or a descendant of any of them; brother, sister, half brother, half sister, or a son or daughter of any of them; father, mother, or an ancestor or sibling of either of them; stepbrother, stepsister, stepfather, stepmother, or an in-law"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "child"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent_relative"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "in_law"}]}

  - id: dependent.h_qr_rel
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4: A qualifying relative is one of the listed relatives (of you, or of your spouse on a joint return), or any other person (other than your spouse) who lived with you all year as a member of your household if your relationship didn't violate local law"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_listed, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.spouse_relative, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.qr_all_year, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.lawful, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_qr
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4: Does any person meet the conditions to be your qualifying relative? (not a qualifying child of any taxpayer, gross income of less than $5,200, and you provided over half of the person's support)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qr_rel, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.other_claimant, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.other_nontaxpayer, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [dependent.gross_income, {param: qr.gross_income_limit}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.supported, {const: true}]}
    note: "The sheltered-workshop exception to the gross income test is not encoded; the interface gives only gross income. Multiple support agreements, the divorced-parents rule and kidnapped children are refused on dependent.claimed."

  - id: dependent.claimed
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can claim this person as a dependent (Step 2 for a qualifying child, Step 4 for a qualifying relative)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qr, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.canada_mexico, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [sa.dependent, {const: false}]}
    refuses: [dependent.married, dependent.divorced_rule, dependent.multiple_support, dependent.kidnapped]
    note: "'Could you be claimed as a dependent on someone else's 2025 tax return?' is read from sa.dependent, the only supplied answer to it, and as the flowchart says it is not asked on a joint return. A married person, the divorced-parents rule, a multiple support agreement and a kidnapped child are refused, not computed."

  - id: dependent.ctc_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3: You can claim the child tax credit for this person (qualifying child who is your dependent, with an SSN, ITIN or ATIN, a U.S. citizen, national or resident alien, under age 17 at the end of 2025, and you, or your spouse if filing a joint return, and this child have SSNs valid for employment)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.tin, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: ctc.age_limit}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.work_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.ctc_ssn, {const: true}]}
    note: "The filer's side of Step 3, question 4 (one spouse with an SSN valid for employment, the other with an SSN or ITIN) is read from household.ctc_ssn. Its computation is not supplied; this assumes it is that requirement."

  - id: dependent.odc_person
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can claim the credit for other dependents for this person (Step 3, question 3, or Step 5)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.tin, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.all_tin, {const: true}]}
    note: "The filer's SSN or ITIN requirement (Before you begin; Step 5, question 1) is read from household.all_tin. Its computation is not supplied; this assumes it is that requirement. It is applied to every other dependent, including a qualifying child aged 17 or over, because 'Before you begin' states it for the credit generally."

  - id: dependent.h_ctc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Schedule 8812, line 5: $2,200 for each qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ctc.per_child}

  - id: dependent.h_odc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Schedule 8812, line 7: $500 for each other dependent"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: odc.per_dependent}

  - id: dependent.h_actc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Schedule 8812, line 16b: $1,700 for each qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: actc.per_child}

  - id: dependent.ctc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's part of Schedule 8812, line 5 (number of qualifying children under age 17 with the required social security number, multiplied by $2,200)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.h_ctc_per
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}
          then: dependent.h_zero

  - id: dependent.odc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's part of Schedule 8812, line 7 (number of other dependents multiplied by $500)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.odc_person, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.h_odc_per
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.odc_person, {const: false}]}
          then: dependent.h_zero

  - id: dependent.actc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's part of Schedule 8812, line 16b (number of qualifying children under age 17 with the required social security number x $1,700)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.h_actc_per
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}
          then: dependent.h_zero
    note: "Meaning inferred from Schedule 8812, line 16b, which uses the same children as line 4."

  - id: dependent.h_hoh2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Head of household, Test 2: this person lived with you for more than half of the year and is a person whom you can claim as a dependent (not one who is your dependent only because the person lived with you for all of 2025), or your unmarried qualifying child who isn't your dependent"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, ge: [dependent.months, {const: 7, type: Count}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - op: test
                  any:
                    - {op: test, eq: [dependent.born_died, {const: true}]}
                    - {op: test, eq: [dependent.placed, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.part_year_home, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_listed, {const: true}]}
    note: "Married qualifying children, children under the divorced-parents rule and multiple support agreements (Test 2, items 1a, 1c, 3 and 4) are refused through dependent.h_qc and dependent.claimed. A relative of your spouse only is not counted, since a head of household does not file jointly."

  - id: dependent.hoh_absence
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person may qualify you for head of household under Test 2, and time counted as lived with you includes an absence from which it was not reasonable to assume the absent person would return, or during which you did not keep up the home"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_hoh2, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.absence_no_return, {const: true}]}
    note: "Pub. 501 counts a temporary absence only if it is reasonable to assume the absent person will return and you keep up the home. The pages do not say how to recount the time otherwise, so this line only flags the situation."

  - id: dependent.hoh_test2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Head of household, Test 2: this person is a qualifying person who lived with you for more than half of the year"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_hoh2, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.hoh_test1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Head of household, Test 1: you paid over half the cost of keeping up a home that was the main home for all of 2025 of your parent whom you can claim as a dependent"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.parent_home_paid, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.eic_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Step 3: this person meets the conditions to be your qualifying child for the purpose of claiming the EIC"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc_rel, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc_age, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.joint_return, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.us_half, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [dependent.married, dependent.kidnapped]
    note: "There is no support test for the EIC. The married-child rule and the kidnapped-child rule (Pub. 596) are refused. The tie-breaker rules for a qualifying child of more than one person cannot be decided from the interface; listing the child is read as the filer claiming the child under those rules."

  - id: dependent.eic_ssn_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC qualifying child who has a valid SSN issued on or before the due date of your return (including extensions)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_ssn, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.dc_qp
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 2441 qualifying person: a qualifying child under age 13 whom you can claim as a dependent, or a person who wasn't physically or mentally able to care for themselves, lived with you for more than half the year and whom you can claim as a dependent"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
                - op: test
                  any:
                    - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
                    - op: test
                      all:
                        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
                        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_under13, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_incapable, {const: true}]}
                - op: test
                  any:
                    - {op: test, ge: [dependent.months, {const: 7, type: Count}]}
                    - op: test
                      all:
                        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.born_died, {const: true}]}
                        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.part_year_home, {const: true}]}
    note: "A child aged 13 at the end of 2025 turned 13 during the year and qualifies only for care provided before the birthday (dc_under13); a child 12 or under was under 13 all year. A person who would be a dependent but for gross income, a joint return or the filer's own dependency, and the custodial-parent rule, are outside this slice (asked at the Form 2441 level). Only birth or death, as Pub. 503 states, relaxes the half-year test here."

  - id: dependent.dc_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One person for the count of qualifying persons on Form 2441, line 2"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: param, ref: dc.one}
    note: "A Count cannot be selected by a condition with these atoms, so this is the unit count (1) for every listed person. A form that counts qualifying persons must filter on dependent.dc_qp."

  - id: dependent.dc_line2d
    printed: "2(d)"
    label: "Qualified expenses you incurred and paid in 2025 for the person listed in column (a)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.dc_paid
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: false}]}
          then: dependent.h_zero
    shown_when: dependent.dc_qp
    note: "A person is listed on line 2 only if a qualifying person; otherwise the amount is zero. Benefits shown on Form 2441, line 28 are not removed here; the supplied expense figure includes them and Form 2441, Part III takes them out."

  - id: dependent.dc_line2c
    printed: "2(c)"
    label: "Check here if the qualifying person was over age 12 and was disabled"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_incapable, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, gt: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_over12_care, {const: true}]}
    shown_when: dependent.dc_qp
    note: "A person aged 14 or more at the end of 2025 was over age 12 throughout 2025, so the box follows from the disability alone. A person aged 13 turned 13 during 2025, so the box depends on whether any included care was provided at 13 or older. A person 12 or under was never over age 12 in 2025."

  - id: dependent.h_ptc_counts
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 8962, line 2b: a dependent who is required to file an income tax return because their income meets the income tax return filing threshold"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.ptc_files, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.ptc_magi_counted
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This dependent's modified AGI included in Form 8962, line 2b (Worksheet 1-2); not included for a dependent not required to file or filing only to claim a refund"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_ptc_counts, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.ptc_magi
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_ptc_counts, {const: false}]}
          then: dependent.h_zero

  - id: dependent.h_edu_student
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "A dependent you claim on your tax return for whom qualified education expenses were paid, who received Form 1098-T (or meets its exceptions) and was issued a TIN by the due date of your 2025 return (including extensions)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_1098t, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_tin_issued, {const: true}]}
    note: "The filer's own TIN requirement and the return-level limits (filing status, MAGI) belong to Form 8863 and are not applied here."

  - id: dependent.h_edu_aoc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "The student qualifies for the American opportunity credit (line 23 No, line 24 Yes, line 25 No, line 26 No, and the institution's EIN is provided)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_student, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line23, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line24, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line25, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line26, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_ein, {const: true}]}
    note: "Where the student qualifies for the American opportunity credit it is taken instead of the lifetime learning credit, which the instructions say is never the greater. Without the EIN the student falls to line 31."

  - id: dependent.h_edu_llc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "The student's expenses are entered on line 31 (lifetime learning credit) because the American opportunity credit is not claimed for this student"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_student, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_aoc, {const: false}]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_aoc_exp
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted Qualified Education Expenses Worksheet, line 1 (American opportunity credit): tuition, required fees and course materials, whether or not bought from the institution"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_inst, dependent.edu_mat]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_adj
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted Qualified Education Expenses Worksheet, line 3: Total adjustments (add lines 2a, 2b, and 2c)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_a2025, dependent.edu_a2026, dependent.edu_refunds]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_over_refused
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Tax-free assistance and refunds allocable to an academic period were more than that period's expenses (the worksheet is completed for each academic period)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_student, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, gt: [dependent.h_edu_adj, {const: 0}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_over, {const: true}]}
    note: "The worksheet is per academic period, but the interface gives yearly totals. Subtracting totals is right only when no period's adjustments exceed its expenses, so the other case is refused."

  - id: dependent.h_edu_aoc_adjusted
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted Qualified Education Expenses Worksheet, line 4 (American opportunity credit): Subtract line 3 from line 1. If zero or less, enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.h_edu_aoc_exp, take: dependent.h_edu_adj}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_cap
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 27 limit: $4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: aoc.expense_cap}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_aoc_capped
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses, not more than $4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [dependent.h_edu_aoc_adjusted, dependent.h_edu_cap]}

  - id: dependent.edu_line27
    printed: "27"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses (see instructions). Don't enter more than $4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_aoc, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.h_edu_aoc_capped
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_aoc, {const: false}]}
          then: dependent.h_zero
    refuses: [dependent.h_edu_over_refused]
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.edu_line28
    printed: "28"
    label: "Subtract $2,000 from line 27. If zero or less, enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.edu_line27, take: {param: aoc.full_band}}
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.edu_line29
    printed: "29"
    label: "Multiply line 28 by 25% (0.25)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: multiply_rate, amount: dependent.edu_line28, rate: {param: aoc.second_rate}}
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.h_edu_band
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$2,000 (line 30)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: aoc.full_band}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_line29_plus
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Add $2,000 to the amount on line 29"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.h_edu_band, dependent.edu_line29]}

  - id: dependent.edu_line30
    printed: "30"
    label: "If line 28 is zero, enter the amount from line 27. Otherwise, add $2,000 to the amount on line 29 and enter the result. Skip line 31. Include the total of all amounts from all Parts III, line 30, on Part I, line 1"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line28, {const: 0}]}
          then: dependent.edu_line27
        - guard: {op: test, ne: [dependent.edu_line28, {const: 0}]}
          then: dependent.h_edu_line29_plus
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.h_edu_llc_adjusted
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted Qualified Education Expenses Worksheet, line 4 (lifetime learning credit): tuition, required fees and amounts required to be paid to the institution, less total adjustments. If zero or less, enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.edu_inst, take: dependent.h_edu_adj}

  - id: dependent.edu_line31
    printed: "31"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses (see instructions). Include the total of all amounts from all Parts III, line 31, on Part II, line 10"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_llc, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.h_edu_llc_adjusted
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_llc, {const: false}]}
          then: dependent.h_zero
    refuses: [dependent.h_edu_over_refused]
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_llc
    note: "Other course materials not required to be paid to the institution count only for the American opportunity credit, so line 31 uses only the expenses that had to be paid to the institution."
```

<!-- end -->
